title: San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite
description: Experience the Magic of San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite
long_description:
Experience the Magic of San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite
Prepare to immerse yourself in the vibrant rhythms of Punjabi, Gujarati, English, Telugu, and Hindi music at the 'San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite' on the 16th of October, 2026. Organized by Net Effect Media, this Navratri/Dandiya night party is a cultural extravaganza that promises a night of electrifying dance, delectable food and drinks, and Bollywood-style entertainment. Get ready to twirl your dandiya sticks and groove to the beat of the music under the starry Cupertino night sky.
Unveiling the Artist Behind the Performance
The night's entertainment will be helmed by an exceptional artist, who will enchant you with their mesmerizing performance. Although we can't reveal the artist's identity just yet, rest assured that their rich background in Punjabi, Gujarati, English, Telugu, and Hindi music will create an unforgettable experience. Their unique ability to blend traditional and contemporary styles will surely appeal to the audience, captivating both young and old alike.
About the Celebrated Venue - Marriott Residence Inn
The Marriott Residence Inn, located at 19429 Stevens Creek Blvd, Cupertino, CA, United States, will serve as the grand backdrop for this night of cultural celebration. Known for its safety and accessibility, the hotel provides ample parking and is surrounded by numerous Indian restaurants, adding to the overall convenience of the event. The venue's warm ambiance and state-of-the-art facilities ensure a comfortable and enjoyable experience for all attendees.
Secure Your Tickets Today!
Don't miss out on this enchanting event! We offer a variety of ticket options to suit every attendee. Early bird single tickets are available at $24.00, while a set of 4 can be purchased at just $89.00. If you're coming with a large group, opt for our early bird offer of 10 tickets for $199.00. Regular single tickets are priced at $26.00, with bundle options of 4 and 10 tickets available at $96.00 and $220.00 respectively. If you decide to join us on the day of the event, you can purchase single tickets at the door for $29.00, or sets of 4 and 10 tickets for $108.00 and $249.00 respectively.
